declarations.description:
An inline Bikram Sambat (Nepali) calendar date picker rendered as native DOM, so it works in
React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML.

All calendar math comes from `@nepali-date-picker/core`, the same engine used by the Kotlin,
Android, and Python builds, so dates always agree across platforms.

`<nepali-date-field>` plus a cross-field check that the end is not before the start.

custom properties inherit through the shadow boundary.

declarations.name: toIso
declarations.description: Format a date as a zero-padded `YYYY-MM-DD` string (Latin digits).

declarations.name: parseIso
declarations.description:
Parse a `YYYY-MM-DD` (or `YYYY/MM/DD`) date string into a [CalendarDate].

Devanagari digits are accepted and folded to Latin first. Returns `null` for empty or malformed
input; range validity against the calendar is the caller's responsibility.

declarations.name: sameDate
declarations.description: Structural equality for two dates, tolerating `null`.
